newsitem.title: UK: Rugby union-England name unchanged side for Ireland clash.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-England name unchanged side for Ireland clash.

text.p: England have retained the side who beat Scotland 41-13 in their opening Five Nations' championship match last Saturday for the game against Ireland in Dublin on February 15.
Ireland, beaten in the opening round by France, defeated Wales by a point in Cardiff on Saturday.

England - Tim Stimpson; Jon Sleightholme, Will Carling, Phil de Glanville (captain), Tony Underwood; Paul Grayson, Andy Gomarsall; Tim Rodber, Richard Hill, Lawrence Dallaglio, Martin Johnson, Simon Shaw, Jason Leonard, Mark Regan, Graham Rowntree.
